menu: Absolute knob turned (APC40 TRACK KNOB: sent back to 64)

56.lb: Memory cue MEMORY note (CALL back / next / DELETE = +1..+3)
56.hl: Memory cue MEMORY note (CALL back / next / DELETE = +1..+3)

85.lb: Video FX CC (centre = off; FLX4 CFX knob; -1=none)
85.hl: Video FX CC (centre = off; FLX4 CFX knob; -1=none)

88.lb: Master video FX CC (on the Video FX channel; -1=none)
88.hl: Master video FX CC (on the Video FX channel; -1=none)

92.lb: Tempo fader CC (deck channel; LSB = CC+32; 128 = pitch bend; -1=none)
92.hl: Tempo fader CC (deck channel; LSB = CC+32; 128 = pitch bend; -1=none)

101.hl: Tempo range note (deck channel; -1 = SYNC note + 8, 0 = none)

102.lb: Pad mode button note (deck channel; -1 = no pad modes)
102.hl: Pad mode button note (deck channel; -1 = no pad modes)

103.lb: HOT CUE mode note (pad channel, sent while the mode button is held)
103.hl: HOT CUE mode note (pad channel, sent while the mode button is held)

104.lb: SAMPLER mode note (pad channel, sent while the mode button is held)
104.hl: SAMPLER mode note (pad channel, sent while the mode button is held)

105.lb: SHIFT+pad note offset (0 = the pad notes on the SHIFT channel)
105.hl: SHIFT+pad note offset (0 = the pad notes on the SHIFT channel)

107.hl: Video FX on/off note (Video FX channel; -1 = none)

117.hl: Cue button note (mixer channel: Mixer MIDI channel, 0 = the deck channel; -1 = none)

menu: CDJ (pad 1 note +4..+7 = hot cues 1-4 / A-D; +0..+3 = 5-8 / E-H)

120.lb: Number of hot cue pads (the pad 1 note and the next ones)
120.hl: Number of hot cue pads (the pad 1 note and the next ones)

121.lb: Number of sample select pads (the sample 1 note and the next ones)
121.hl: Number of sample select pads (the sample 1 note and the next ones)

122.hl: Mixer MIDI channel (channel fader, cue button, deck select; 0 = the deck channel)

123.hl: Deck select note (mixer channel; -1 = none. With it, the shared buttons act on the selected deck)

124.hl: Tempo encoder CC (deck channel, relative; selected deck; -1 = none)

125.hl: Nudge - note (deck channel; selected deck; -1 = none)

126.hl: Nudge + note (deck channel; selected deck; -1 = none)

127.hl: Tap tempo note (deck channel; selected deck; -1 = none)

128.hl: Stop note (deck channel; selected deck; -1 = none)

129.hl: Sample 5-8 notes (deck channel, note .. +3; selected deck; -1 = none)

130.hl: Cue mix encoder CC (deck channel, relative; -1 = none)

133.hl: Extra buttons note (held: spinback, reverse, half speed, fast forward; with SHIFT: loop, SYNC, Q, SLIP = +0..+3)

137.hl: Tempo fader centre zone (% of half the travel read as 0 %)

138.hl: AUTO LOOP mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; -1 = none)

139.hl: TOUCH FX mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; -1 = none)

140.hl: SLICER mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; -1 = none)

141.hl: BOUNCE LOOP mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; -1 = none)

142.hl: MEMORY mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; -1 = none)

143.hl: VIDEO FX mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; pads 1-8 = video FX 1-8, the lit one again = off; -1 = none)

145.hl: Loop knob CC (relative: loop length half / double)

146.hl: Loop knob push note (loop on / off)

147.hl: Loop move CC (deck channel, relative: move the loop / jump a beat; 128 + CC = on the loop knob's channel)

148.hl: Reloop note (deck channel; 128 + note = on the loop knob's channel)

149.hl: Back to CUE note (deck channel; the CUE / memory cue called, playing on)

155.hl: Filter morph knob CC (mixer channel; centre = 0; -1 = none)

156.hl: Filter resonance knob CC (mixer channel; -1 = none)

157.hl: Filter cutoff knob CC (mixer channel; centre = off; -1 = none)

158.hl: FILTER TYPE mode note (pad channel, with the mode button; pads 1-8 pick the filter; -1 = none)

159.hl: Video FX amount - button ((channel - 1) * 128 + note; both decks; -1 = none)

160.hl: Video FX amount + button ((channel - 1) * 128 + note; both decks; -1 = none)

161.hl: Master video FX amount - button ((channel - 1) * 128 + note; -1 = none)

162.hl: Master video FX amount + button ((channel - 1) * 128 + note; -1 = none)

163.lb: Master video FX type knob CC
163.hl: Master video FX type knob CC (Video FX channel; left end = Off, then the video FX; -1 = none)

164.hl: Video blend knob CC (Video FX channel; left end = Mix, then the other 8; -1 = none)

166.hl: Browse knob CC (relative: the slot to go to, of the deck it works; -1 = none)

167.hl: Browse push note (go to that slot)

168.hl: SHIFT browse knob CC (relative: headphone cue mix)

169.hl: SHIFT browse push note (the deck the browse knob works: A / B)

170.hl: LOAD note (this deck: the file chosen in the Media Explorer into an empty slot)

171.hl: LOAD replace note (this deck: into the slot in use)

178.hl: Crossfader end value (CC value read as the deck 2 end; APC40 mkII 120: its fader springs back from 127)

180.hl: Hot cues 5-8 row (pad 1 note + this = hot cue 5, with the hot cue pad count; 0 = none. APC40 mkII 8)

181.hl: SHIFT note (deck channel; held: a hot cue pad clears it; -1 = none. APC40 98)

182.hl: Pad mode buttons (first of 8 notes, any channel, the selected deck: HOT CUE, AUTO LOOP, TOUCH FX, SLICER, BOUNCE LOOP, VIDEO FX, FILTER TYPE, PITCH PLAY; -1 = none. APC40 DEVICE 58)

183.hl: Freeze note (mixer channel: sound and picture held while pressed, the song goes on behind; with SHIFT: video FX on / off; -1 = none. APC40 CLIP STOP 52)

184.hl: Loop half note (deck channel, the selected deck; with SHIFT: move the loop a beat back; -1 = none. APC40 97)

185.hl: Loop double note (deck channel, the selected deck; with SHIFT: move the loop a beat on; -1 = none. APC40 96)

187.hl: Echo fader ((channel - 1) * 128 + CC; -1 = none. APC40 TRACK FADER 2 / 6)

188.hl: Bitcrusher fader ((channel - 1) * 128 + CC; -1 = none. APC40 TRACK FADER 3 / 7)

189.hl: Vibrato fader ((channel - 1) * 128 + CC; -1 = none. APC40 TRACK FADER 4 / 8)

190.hl: Crossfader assign note (mixer channel: A, B, off in turn; -1 = none. APC40 mkII 66)

191.hl: Mute note (mixer channel: this deck's sound and picture off / on; -1 = none. APC40 ACTIVATOR 50)

192.hl: Slot back note (deck channel, the selected deck; this + 1 = next; -1 = none. APC40 UP 94)

193.hl: REAPER metronome note (deck channel; -1 = none. APC40 mkII METRONOME 90)

194.hl: REAPER record note (deck channel; -1 = none. APC40 mkII SESSION 102)

208.hl: FX knobs' first CC (deck channel, 8 CCs, the selected deck: the FX knob sliders 200-207; -1 = none. APC40 DEVICE 16)

210.lb: Sound of the video FX fader
210.hl: Sound of the video FX fader ((channel - 1) * 128 + CC; -1 = none. APC40 TRACK FADER 1 / 5)

211.hl: Sample pads scroll back note (any channel, the selected deck: the sample pads show one slot earlier; -1 = none. APC40 LEFT 97)

212.hl: Sample pads scroll on note (any channel, the selected deck: one slot later; -1 = none. APC40 RIGHT 96)

213.hl: Auto loop notes (any channel, 4 notes = 1, 2, 4, 8 beats, the selected deck; -1 = none. APC40 SCENE LAUNCH 1-4 = 82)

214.hl: Knob page notes (any channel, 3 notes = the deck knobs' pages 1-3; -1 = none. APC40 PAN / SENDS / USER = 87)

215.hl: Both decks note (any channel: lit = the shared buttons act on both decks; deck A; -1 = none. APC40 MASTER 80)

216.hl: Effects off while held note (any channel: every video FX and sound effect at 0 while held; -1 = none. APC40 BANK 103)

222.hl: Fader effects on / off channel (the freeze note on this channel and the next 2 = echo, bitcrusher, vibrato on / off; 0 = none. APC40 CLIP STOP 2-4 / 6-8)

225.hl: Effects off while held, this deck's ((channel - 1) * 128 + note; -1 = none. Reloop Buddy SHIFT + FX ON: ch 9 / 10 note 10)

226.hl: SHIFT for the filter knobs ((channel - 1) * 128 + note; held: the filter knobs = echo length, echo feedback, key; -1 = none. Reloop Buddy ch 15 note 0)

227.hl: Video blend note (any channel: the next blend, SHIFT = back; deck A; -1 = none. APC40 METRONOME 90)

228.hl: Search jog CC (deck channel, relative: SHIFT + jog = big jumps; -1 = none. Reloop Buddy 43)

229.hl: Picture mute note (mixer channel: this deck's picture off / on, the sound stays; -1 = none. Reloop Buddy SHIFT + headphone CUE 14)

234.hl: Pad modes by notes (the unit switches its pad modes itself and each mode's pads send their own notes: the layout of its mode buttons and pad notes)

235.hl: Filter cutoff knob channel (0 = the other filter knobs' channel; DDJ-FLX4 CFX: 7)

236.hl: Memory cue buttons' order (MEMORY, then the two CALL buttons in this order, then DELETE)

237.hl: SLIP note (deck channel: slip on / off; -1 = none. CDJ-2000NXS2 0x3A, CDJ-3000 0x07)

238.hl: QUANTIZE note (deck channel: quantize on / off; -1 = none. CDJ-2000NXS2 0x09, CDJ-3000 0x06)

239.hl: REVERSE note (deck channel: each press, backward at 1x on / off; -1 = none. CDJ-2000NXS2 0x21, CDJ-3000 0x19)

240.hl: Held reverse note (deck channel: backward while held, slip comes back; -1 = none. CDJ SLIP REVERSE)

241.hl: Next sample note (deck channel; this + 1 = the sample before; -1 = none. CDJ TRACK SEARCH 0x04)

242.hl: Brake knob CC (deck channel: 'Brake on stop' 0 .. 3 s; -1 = none. CDJ TOUCH/BRAKE 0x1E)

243.hl: Start knob CC (deck channel: 'Start on play' 0 .. 3 s; -1 = none. CDJ-2000NXS2 RELEASE/START 0x1F)

244.hl: Needle search CC (deck channel, while stopped: 1 .. 127 = the place in the sample, 0 = let go; -1 = none. CDJ 0x1C)

245.hl: RELOOP/EXIT note (deck channel: in a loop = out of it, else back into the last loop; -1 = none. CDJ-2000NXS2 0x08, CDJ-3000 0x25)

246.hl: Relative knobs' format (the loop knob, loop move and browse knobs)

247.hl: FX ON bar's combos (while this deck's FX ON bar is on: FX PARAM < > = its video FX type, the FX knob = its amount, SHIFT + the FX knob = its sound of the video FX. Reloop Buddy; (⚪141) most other units: their FX ON on = the bar, their unused FX buttons = FX PARAM < >)

248.hl: Key knob CC (browser channel, relative: the sound of the video FX last touched; with the push held, the key threshold; with SHIFT + push, the key softness; -1 = none. Reloop Buddy BROWSE 0)

257.hl: PREVIEW button ((channel - 1) * 128 + note: this deck's preview of the file chosen in the Media Explorer, as the P key; again = stop; -1 = none. Many presets set it: see the manual)

258.hl: Mode button + LOAD = preview (the pad mode button held: LOAD previews instead of loading, as the P key. Many presets set it: see the manual)

259.hl: METRONOME button ((channel - 1) * 128 + note: the metronome on / off, as the N key; -1 = none)

260.hl: LOAD button, any channel ((channel - 1) * 128 + note: as LOAD note, for a unit that sends LOAD on its deck's channel; -1 = none)

261.hl: LOAD replace button, any channel ((channel - 1) * 128 + note: as LOAD replace note; -1 = none)
